children: BridgeBio reported BBO-8520 plus pembrolizumab showed a 75% ORR at 500 mg QD (53% across doses) and BBO-8520 monotherapy yielded 63% ORR with $344.1 million cash runway into 2028.
BBO-8520 + pembrolizumab in 2L+ G12C inhibitor-experienced NSCLC: 75% ORR at 500 mg QD, 53% ORR across dose levels (N=17).
BBO-8520 monotherapy in 2L+ G12C inhibitor‑naïve NSCLC: 63% ORR (26/41) and 100% DCR (41/41); 75% remained on treatment >6 months (21/28).
BBO-8520 combos show manageable safety with predominantly GI AEs and a favorable liver profile; no grade 3 liver enzyme elevations in monotherapy cohort.
BBO-11818 and BBO-10203 combination cohorts are enrolling in KRAS-mutant CRC and PDAC; monotherapy and combo data planned Q4 2026 and mid-2027.
Financials: $344.1 million in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities as of June 30, 2026, projected to fund operations into 2028.
